summary: Completed testing of iteration 5 features: Categories CRUD with slug field, API Providers CRUD with test connection, Services CRUD with fulfillment fields. All 16 backend tests passed. Frontend verified all 3 admin CRUD pages working correctly.

ui_bugs.issue: Add Category button click intercepted by header overlay - requires force=True or JS click
ui_bugs.note: Button works with JavaScript click, minor z-index issue

issues: Console warning: Missing Description or aria-describedby for DialogContent - accessibility improvement needed

passed_tests: POST /api/admin/categories creates category with slug field
POST /api/admin/categories auto-generates slug from name if not provided
PUT /api/admin/categories/{id} updates category with slug
GET /api/admin/categories returns slug field
DELETE /api/admin/categories/{id} rejects deletion if services exist (returns 400)
DELETE /api/admin/categories/{id} succeeds if no services linked
GET /api/admin/api-providers returns list of providers
POST /api/admin/api-providers creates a provider
PUT /api/admin/api-providers/{id} updates provider
DELETE /api/admin/api-providers/{id} deletes provider
POST /api/admin/api-providers/test tests connection (returns success:false for fake URL)
POST /api/admin/services with fulfillmentType=auto, providerId, providerServiceId
GET /api/admin/services returns fulfillmentType, providerId, providerServiceId fields
Service types: Default, Refill 30d, Refill 60d, Refill 90d, Drip Feed, Custom all work
GET /api/categories (public) returns slug field
Admin login via /admin/login works correctly
Admin sidebar shows 'API Providers' link under Content section
/admin/categories page shows slug column, Add Category button opens modal with name+slug+status
Typing category name auto-generates slug (Test Auto Slug -> test-auto-slug)
Delete category shows confirmation dialog; if services exist shows error message and disables Delete button
/admin/services page has Type column with badges (Default, Refill 30d, Refill 60d, Refill 90d, Drip Feed)
/admin/services modal has fulfillment section (Manual/Auto radio), provider dropdown when Auto selected
/admin/api-providers page loads with table and Add API Provider button
API Providers modal has name, URL, API key (with show/hide), markup, status, test connection
critical_code_review_comments: Consider adding aria-describedby to Dialog components for accessibility compliance
